text:
alex: Quick check — I'm prepping a version bump to v2.14.0 and will create an annotated tag + GH draft. Anyone object to letting CI attach the SBOM and the build artifacts?

mira: SGTM. Please add the API rename note to the changelog entry (tiny paragraph).

jamie: on it, will scan the changelog now. timeline for tagging?

alex: aim to tag in ~30m after jamie's nitfix. Plan: tag -> push -> draft release -> attach artifacts from CI.

deploy-bot: Build succeeded for commit abc123 (pipeline #402). Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-rc/builds/1876500000/ 

mira: added changelog entry under Unreleased and included the migration note. Leaving a TODO to add dedicated-customer caveat.

jamie: small nit: header level should be "### Changed" not "## Changed" — pushing a quick fix.

alex: thanks. My tag command locally will be:
```
git tag -a v2.14.0 -m "Release v2.14.0: changelog + SBOM"
git push origin v2.14.0
```

alex: after that I'll create the GH draft (set to draft) and attach the artifacts.

lina: FYI for Dedicated customers — include this snippet in the release notes:
"Note: this release requires inference runtime >= 1.9 for quantized weights."

jamie: pushed the nitfix (commit abc124). CI ran, all green.

alex: tagging now.

release-bot: Annotated tag v2.14.0 created by alex (commit abc124) at 1876500150.

alex: Draft release created: https://github.com/redwood/release-drafts/v2.14.0 (status: Draft).

mira: can you add SHA256 checksums to the assets area? I built them locally and verified.

jamie: how are we generating checksums for artifacts? I usually run:
```
sha256sum artifact.tar.gz > artifact.tar.gz.sha256
```

mira: I have a file `sha256sums.txt` ready. Attaching to the draft would be great.

alex: uploaded sbom.json and sha256sums.txt to the draft assets. Also added a short note about the API rename.

jamie: reviewed the draft, lgtm. :thumbsup:

mira: approving the draft as well.

alex: reassigning final publish to @release-coordinator for a timed publish tomorrow PST 09:00 so EU churn is lower.

release-coordinator: Got it — scheduled publish job for 2026-03-18T09:00:00-08:00. I'll run the publish script and monitor logs + notify #incidents if anything spikes.

alex: thanks everyone — closing loop. If anything else pops up ping me here and I'll hold the publish.
